title: Law of Turkmenistan on Protection of Atmospheric Air (Об охране атмосферного воздуха; Atmosfera howasyny goramak hakynda)
citation: Law of Turkmenistan on Protection of Atmospheric Air, signed 2016-03-26, No. 366-V (Vedomosti Mejlisa Turkmenistana 2016, No. 1, art. 51); text with amendments through the Law of 2021-11-13 No. 429-VI
evidence: Статья 47, as served by the Mejlis: «1. Настоящий Закон вступает в силу со дня его официального опубликования.» The page gives no publication date, so no in-force date is established; the law is dated 2016-03-26 (No. 366-V). Opened https://mejlis.gov.tm/single-law/92?lang=ru on 2026-11-03.
notes: Article 36 (ru: Инвентаризация выбросов парниковых газов в атмосферный воздух) obliges legal entities and individuals whose activity involves greenhouse gas emissions to carry out an inventory of those emissions; the procedure is set by the authorised environmental body (a separate order, not found on the Mejlis site). The earlier register row carried F7; it carries a reporting duty, so it is F3 here. Stored on 2026-11-03: one consolidated record per language (Turkmen tk, Russian ru) from the Mejlis page, which serves only the current text, headed as amended through the Law of 2021-11-13 No. 429-VI; there is no list of earlier versions, so no earlier version is stored. The record in_force (2021-11-13) is the signing date of the last amending law named in the heading; the page states no commencement date for it. The Mejlis Russian page is marked '*Перевод с государственного языка Туркменистана' (a translation from the state language, issued on the Mejlis site; stored under the same row on the strength of Article 7 of the Law on Copyright and Related Rights, which covers 'официальные переводы'). No government English text: looked on https://mejlis.gov.tm/single-law/92?lang=en (an empty page shell with no law text), on cbt.tm and on minjust.gov.tm (no legal database or English translations of laws found).
